meta.title: 99 Nights in the Forest materials data
notes: Ordinary food and taming bait rows are intentionally excluded. Anvil Parts are excluded because checked sources frame them as Tool Workshop assembly pieces, not farmed materials. Forest Gem Fragment and Forest Gem are split because fragments are obtained from routes while the full gem is made by merging four fragments and spent on top-tier crafting.

items.name: Log
items.source: Throughout the map, trees, and Large Cabin
items.craftingUses: Fuel the Campfire or grind into 1 Wood
items.farmingTip: Use logs for fire when you are safe on Wood; grind them when crafting is the bottleneck.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists Log under Resource.

items.name: Chair
items.craftingUses: Fuel the Campfire or grind into 5 Wood
items.farmingTip: Chairs are better Wood pickups than logs when you need crafting resources quickly.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists Chair under Resource.

items.name: Biofuel
items.farmingTip: Turn extra eligible drops into Biofuel only after checking whether a recipe or trader route needs them.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists Biofuel under Resource.

items.name: Coal
items.farmingTip: Coal is a better fire pickup than basic logs when night is close.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists Coal under Resource.

items.name: Purple Fur Tuft
items.craftingUses: Give to The Deer during the hurt-deer route; unused tufts can fuel the Campfire after the Bat Cave unlock
items.farmingTip: Treat this as a Deer route item first and fuel only after the unlock use is handled.
items.sourceNote: Items and Purple Fur Tuft pages agree it is tied to The Deer/Bat Cave/Grove route.

items.name: Fuel Canister
items.source: Throughout the map, Chests, and Structures
items.farmingTip: Save Fuel Canisters if you are using Flamethrower routes; otherwise they are strong Campfire fuel.
items.sourceNote: Items page also lists deleted Bird Watcher and Trick-or-Treating sources; current routes remain map/chest/structure based.

items.name: Oil Barrel
items.source: Throughout the map, Legendary Chests, Gold Chests, Structures, and Oil Drill
items.location: Map loot, high-value chests, structures, and Oil Drill
items.farmingTip: Oil Barrels are high-value fuel, so carry them when a late night or Flamethrower route is coming.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists Oil Barrel under Resource.

items.name: Cultist Corpse
items.craftingUses: Fuel the Campfire or sacrifice to the Volcano for 1 charge
items.farmingTip: Use cultist corpses as short-term fire or Volcano charge value after combat.
items.sourceNote: Items page groups cultist corpse variants together.

items.name: Crossbow Cultist Corpse
items.craftingUses: Fuel the Campfire or sacrifice to the Volcano for 1 charge
items.farmingTip: Do not route for this alone; treat it as extra value after clearing cultist threats.
items.sourceNote: Items page groups cultist corpse variants together.

items.name: Juggernaut Cultist Corpse
items.craftingUses: Fuel the Campfire or sacrifice to the Volcano for 1 charge
items.farmingTip: Only count this as bonus value after you can handle stronger cultist fights.
items.sourceNote: Items page groups cultist corpse variants together.

items.name: Cultist King Corpse
items.craftingUses: Fuel the Campfire or sacrifice to the Volcano for 2 charges
items.farmingTip: This is boss-route value, not an early fuel plan.
items.sourceNote: Items page says the Cultist King corpse is worth 2 Volcano charges.

items.name: Alien Corpse
items.craftingUses: Fuel the Campfire or sacrifice to the Volcano
items.farmingTip: Treat alien corpses as event-route fuel after a UFO crash, not a normal forest pickup.
items.sourceNote: Aliens page describes UFO crash and Mothership encounters.

items.name: Elite Alien Corpse
items.craftingUses: Fuel the Campfire or sacrifice to the Volcano
items.farmingTip: Only chase this when you are already clearing the Mothership route.
items.sourceNote: Aliens page describes Elite Aliens inside the Mothership.

items.name: Wolf Corpse
items.craftingUses: Fuel the Campfire or sacrifice to the Volcano
items.farmingTip: Use it as route fuel when a structure already has one nearby.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists Structures as the source for Wolf Corpse.

items.name: Alpha Wolf Corpse
items.craftingUses: Fuel the Campfire or sacrifice to the Volcano
items.farmingTip: Pick it up when structure routing gives safe carry space.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists Structures as the source for Alpha Wolf Corpse.

items.name: Bear Corpse
items.farmingTip: Carry it back when you need stronger fuel and have enough bag space.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists Structures as the source and does not list Volcano sacrifice for Bear Corpse.

items.name: Bolt
items.source: Throughout the map, Structures, and Fishing
items.farmingTip: Pick up small scrap items early because they convert straight into recipe progress.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists Bolt under Scrap.

items.name: Sheet Metal
items.source: Throughout the map, Structures, and Fishing
items.farmingTip: Treat it as a simple low-value scrap pickup.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists Sheet Metal under Scrap.

items.name: UFO Junk
items.farmingTip: Collect it while clearing alien routes instead of routing there only for one Scrap.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists UFO Junk under Scrap.

items.name: UFO Component
items.farmingTip: Worth carrying over 1-Scrap junk when bag space is tight.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists UFO Component under Scrap.

items.name: Broken Fan
items.source: Throughout the map, Structures, and Fishing
items.farmingTip: A good early pickup when you need medium scrap without combat.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists Broken Fan under Scrap.

items.name: Old Radio
items.source: Throughout the map, Structures, Fishing, and Trick-or-Treating
items.location: Map loot, structures, fishing, and event route
items.farmingTip: Use current map, structure, or fishing routes; Trick-or-Treating is only an event source.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists Trick-or-Treating as an extra event source.

items.name: Broken Microwave
items.source: Throughout the map, Structures, Fishing, and Trick-or-Treating
items.location: Map loot, structures, fishing, and event route
items.farmingTip: High enough value to keep when you need Scrap for several recipes.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists Trick-or-Treating as an extra event source.

items.name: Tire
items.source: Throughout the map, Structures, and Fishing
items.farmingTip: Carry tires when you need 3-Scrap pickups and have room.
items.sourceNote: Items page uses the file/link spelling Tyre but visible name Tire.

items.name: Metal Chair
items.farmingTip: Useful clinic pickup when you are already looting for healing and resources.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists Metal Chair under Scrap.

items.name: Old Car Engine
items.source: Throughout the map, Structures, and Fishing
items.farmingTip: Prioritize it over low-value junk when your sack is close to full.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists Old Car Engine under Scrap.

items.name: Washing Machine
items.farmingTip: A strong scrap pickup if you can carry it back safely.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists Washing Machine under Scrap.

items.name: Cultist Experiment
items.source: Completing Cultist Stronghold and Polar Bear Cave
items.dropSource: Cultist Stronghold and Polar Bear Cave rewards
items.location: Cultist Stronghold and Polar Bear Cave
items.farmingTip: Treat it as late-route scrap because its sources are much riskier than basic structures.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists Cultist Experiment under Scrap.

items.name: Cultist Prototype
items.source: Completing Cultist Stronghold and Polar Bear Cave
items.dropSource: Cultist Stronghold and Polar Bear Cave rewards
items.location: Cultist Stronghold and Polar Bear Cave
items.farmingTip: Use it as bonus Scrap from dangerous objectives rather than a normal early farm.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists Cultist Prototype under Scrap.

items.name: UFO Scrap
items.farmingTip: Best gathered while clearing UFO content because it is valuable but route-gated.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists UFO Scrap under Scrap.

items.name: Wood
items.craftingUses: Crafting Bench recipes and core camp progression
items.farmingTip: Do not burn every Log if your next Bench upgrade or defense needs Wood.
items.sourceNote: Fandom Materials category and Items page both list Wood as a core material.

items.name: Scrap
items.craftingUses: Crafting Bench, Tool Workshop, ammo and utility recipes
items.farmingTip: Use higher-value scrap items first when recipe costs climb.
items.risk: Safe to late loot, depending on source item
items.sourceNote: Fandom Materials category and Items page both list Scrap as a core material.

items.name: Cultist Gem
items.source: Last-standing Cultists, Cultist Stronghold, Ice Temple, and Fishing
items.location: Cultist routes, Ice Temple, and fishing
items.craftingUses: Crafting Bench recipes, Tool Workshop recipes, and summoning Cultist King with 4 gems in the Volcanic Biome
items.farmingTip: Save four gems if your next goal is the Cultist King summon; otherwise spend only when a recipe is worth the route.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists Crafting Bench, Tool Workshop, and Cultist King summon uses.

items.name: Forest Gem Fragment
items.source: Cultist Stronghold, Ice Temple, Ruby Chests, Gold Chests, 100+ day Cultist raids, and Fishing
items.dropSource: Late cultist, chest, and fishing routes
items.location: Cultist Stronghold, Ice Temple, high-value chests, late raids, and fishing
items.craftingUses: Merge 4 fragments into a Forest Gem
items.farmingTip: Count fragments as progress toward one full Forest Gem before spending top-tier crafting plans.
items.sourceNote: Gem of the Forest page says fragments are obtained from late routes and can be dragged together to make a full gem.

items.name: Forest Gem
items.craftingUses: Crafting Bench Tier 5 and top-tier structures such as Weather Machine, Temporal Accelerometer, and Respawn Capsule
items.farmingTip: Do not plan tier 5 crafting until you have enough fragments for the full gem.
items.sourceNote: Also known as Gem of the Forest in source pages.

items.name: Mossy Coin
items.source: Throughout the map, killing Cultists, and Trick-or-Treating
items.craftingUses: Purchase Furniture from the Furniture Trader
items.farmingTip: Use current map and Cultist routes first; Trick-or-Treating is event-dependent.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists Trick-or-Treating as an extra event source.

items.name: Flower
items.source: Throughout the map, Fairy garden, and Fairy Rings
items.farmingTip: Flower color is cosmetic in checked sources, so prioritize quantity for seed purchases.
items.sourceNote: Items page says flowers come in several colors but function the same.

items.name: Sapling
items.craftingUses: Plant to grow a normal tree after one in-game day
items.farmingTip: Use Saplings to keep future Wood routes alive instead of treating every tree as a one-time pickup.
items.rarityOrValue: Chance from normal trees; guaranteed 4 from big trees
items.sourceNote: Items page gives the one-day growth and tree-drop note.

items.name: Sacrifice Totem
items.craftingUses: Sacrifice to the Volcano for 2 charges
items.farmingTip: Save it for Volcano charge progress instead of treating it like normal camp loot.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists Sacrifice Totem under Materials.

items.name: Bunny Foot
items.craftingUses: Pelt Trader trades, Biofuel, Tool Workshop, Warm Clothing Shop, and Bandage crafting
items.farmingTip: Save Bunny Foot for Bandages or early trader value before turning extras into Biofuel.
items.sourceNote: Bandage sources confirm Bunny Foot is a workshop ingredient.

items.name: Wolf Pelt
items.craftingUses: Pelt Trader trades, Biofuel, Tool Workshop, and Bandage crafting
items.farmingTip: Keep early Wolf Pelts because Bandages and workshop recipes can need them quickly.
items.sourceNote: Wolf page lists Wolf Pelt as a wolf drop; Bandage sources confirm a recipe use.

items.name: Alpha Wolf Pelt
items.source: Alpha Wolf and Guard Alpha Wolf
items.craftingUses: Pelt Trader trades, Biofuel, and Tool Workshop recipes
items.farmingTip: Save these for higher workshop recipes before converting extras to Biofuel.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists Alpha Wolf Pelt under Pelts.

items.name: Bear Pelt
items.craftingUses: Pelt Trader trades, Biofuel, and Tool Workshop recipes
items.farmingTip: Bear Pelts feed more expensive workshop choices, so avoid wasting early copies.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists Bear Pelt under Pelts.

items.name: Arctic Fox Pelt
items.farmingTip: Save it for cold protection because checked sources say it cannot be turned into Biofuel.
items.sourceNote: Items page says Arctic Fox Pelt cannot be turned into Biofuel.

items.name: Polar Bear Pelt
items.farmingTip: Treat it as warm-clothing progress rather than Biofuel.
items.sourceNote: Items page says Polar Bear Pelt cannot be turned into Biofuel.

items.name: Mammoth Tusk
items.farmingTip: Only chase tusks once your team can survive large cold-biome threats.
items.sourceNote: Tool Workshop source confirms Mammoth Helmet uses Mammoth Tusk.

items.name: Scorpion Shell
items.farmingTip: Save shells for Infernal Helmet attempts; they are not Biofuel items.
items.sourceNote: Tool Workshop source confirms Infernal Helmet uses Scorpion Shell.

items.name: Cultist King Antler
items.farmingTip: Plan around this only after the Cultist King route is realistic for your run.
items.sourceNote: Tool Workshop source confirms Infernal Helmet uses Cultist King Antler.

items.name: Dripleaf
items.farmingTip: Check pond routes when potion crafting is the goal.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists Dripleaf under Potion Ingredients.

items.name: Moonflower Bulb
items.farmingTip: Harvest it at night only, so plan the route before morning breaks the loop.
items.sourceNote: Items page says Moonflower Bulb can only be harvested at night.

items.name: Stareweed Petal
items.source: Throughout the map; shine a Flashlight on Stareweed to harvest
items.farmingTip: Bring a Flashlight before routing for Stareweed Petals.
items.sourceNote: Items page says Stareweed must be shined with a Flashlight before harvest.

items.name: Cave Vine Flower
items.farmingTip: Route for it when you are already entering caves or mineshafts.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists Cave Vine Flower under Potion Ingredients.

items.name: Mandrake
items.farmingTip: Do not plan a normal run around Mandrake unless the Trick-or-Treat route is available.
items.sourceNote: Items page lists Mandrake as a Potion Ingredient, but the individual Mandrake page did not resolve during source check.

items.name: Meteor Shard
items.source: Meteor Crabs, Meteor Crystals, and Obsidiron Crystals
items.dropSource: Meteor Crab, Meteor Crystal, Obsidiron Crystal
items.location: Meteor Shower and Meteor Workshop routes
items.farmingTip: Save shards for Meteor Anvil crafts because every listed Meteor Anvil recipe spends them.
items.sourceNote: Tool Workshop and Meteor Event pages list Meteor Shard as a Meteor Anvil material.

items.name: Gold Shard
items.location: Meteor Shower and Meteor Workshop routes
items.craftingUses: Meteor Anvil trim kits and Obsidiron Chest Blueprint
items.farmingTip: Keep Gold Shards for trim kits or blueprint crafting instead of treating them as generic loot.
items.sourceNote: Tool Workshop and Meteor Event pages list Gold Shard as a Meteor Anvil material.

items.name: Raw Obsidiron Ore
items.source: Mine an Obsidiron Crystal with an Axe
items.craftingUses: Process into Raw Obsidiron Ore (Shard), then Scalding Obsidiron Ingot, then Obsidiron Ingot
items.farmingTip: This is the first step of the Obsidiron Ingot chain, not the final crafting ingredient.
items.sourceNote: Items page uses the in-game spelling Obsidiron.

items.name: Raw Obsidiron Ore (Shard)
items.source: Smash Raw Obsidiron Ore against the ground
items.farmingTip: Do not stop here; the shard still needs the lava and water steps before it becomes a usable ingot.
items.sourceNote: Items page gives the smash step for the ore shard.

items.name: Scalding Obsidiron Ingot
items.source: Dip Raw Obsidiron Ore (Shard) in lava
items.craftingUses: Process into Obsidiron Ingot by dipping it in water
items.farmingTip: Keep going to the water step; Scalding Obsidiron Ingot is an intermediate state.
items.sourceNote: Items page gives the lava step for the scalding ingot.

items.name: Obsidiron Ingot
items.source: Dip Scalding Obsidiron Ingot in water
items.location: Water processing route after lava step
items.craftingUses: Meteor Anvil recipes, including Obsidiron Boots and Obsidiron Chest Blueprint
items.farmingTip: This is the final chain item and the one Meteor Anvil recipes actually spend.
items.sourceNote: Tool Workshop source confirms Obsidiron Ingot recipe uses at the Meteor Anvil.
